changelog: v0.2.1 bug-fix release. patch.py: RFC 6902 compliance fix. The 'remove' op now correctly returns exit 1 when the target path does not exist (previously silently returned 0). This matches the RFC and lets agents detect failed removals in CI pipelines. Also catches out-of-bounds array indices for /items/N where N >= len(items). No CLI changes. Regression tested: existing-key remove + array-index remove still work.
